topics.label: Numbers to 1000: place value, reading/writing, comparing, ordering, patterns, odd and even
Addition and subtraction within 1000, including regrouping and missing numbers
Multiplication and division: equal groups, repeated addition, sharing and grouping
Multiplication tables of 2, 5 and 10
Multiplication tables of 3 and 4
Word problems (up to 2 steps) for the four operations
Fractions: part of a whole, comparing/ordering unit and like fractions, adding/subtracting like fractions within one whole
Money: counting, decimal notation, converting between dollars and cents, adding/subtracting in dollars only or cents only
Length in m and cm: measuring, comparing, word problems
Mass in kg and g: measuring, comparing, word problems
Volume of liquid in litres: measuring, comparing, word problems
Time: telling time to the minute, a.m./p.m., hours and minutes, duration
2D shapes (incl. semicircle, quarter circle), 3D shapes, patterns, composing figures
Picture graphs with scales
Numbers to 10 000: place value, comparing, ordering, patterns, odd and even
topics.note: Odd and even numbers are a P2 outcome; the P3 set is retained revision.

topics.label: Addition and subtraction within 10 000
Multiplication tables of 6, 7, 8 and 9 and related division
Multiplication and division up to 3 digits by 1 digit, with remainder
Word problems with the four operations, including comparison models
Money in decimal notation: adding, subtracting, word problems
Equivalent fractions; comparing/ordering unlike fractions; adding/subtracting related fractions within one whole
Length (km, m, cm), mass (kg, g), volume (l, ml): compound units and conversion
Time: seconds, 24-hour clock, duration, start and end times, conversion
Area and perimeter: square units, rectangles and squares
Angles: right angles, comparing angles
Perpendicular and parallel lines
Bar graphs: reading, interpreting, completing
Performance tasks, investigations, journals and explaining reasoning in words
topics.note: Assessed by schools through performance/investigative tasks; not captured by objective selection.

topics.label: Structured/long-answer questions with full written workings
topics.note: The app checks only the final selected answer; method production is external.

limitations: Leaf records are an author working map drawn from the MOE syllabus (PDF pp33–36) and need independent page-by-page verification before freezing IDs or computing release coverage.
P3 Mathematics is locked in the Pilot app until the post-Pilot teaching flow exists; its content is prepared but is not a P2 release prerequisite.
Objective selection does not assess written workings, explanations or drawing; those leaves are marked partial or external.
Three questions per repair target are initial stock, not a complete transfer pool for every imported mistake.
